prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1118; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle, insured under your policy, struck our client's vehicle while turning left. Our client sustained serious injuries and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has been in contact with our client, please inform us immediately.

We request that you provide the declarations page and the full policy limits for all applicable liability coverage under the policy issued to your insured, along with confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data and telematics, repair or total-loss records, adjuster notes, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Please take steps to ensure this material is not altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.
